programme.desc: Peter Parker was abandoned by his parents when he was still a child, and was raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Somewhat marginalized at school, Peter wants to know his past and find out who he is, but there he meets his first love, Gwen Stacy. When Peter discovers a briefcase that belonged to his father, he begins a search to learn how his parents disappeared, something that will take him to Oscorp and the laboratory of his father's former partner, Dr. Connor, where he is bitten by an experimentally modified spider that gives him incredible powers. The murder of his uncle by a thief will make him seek revenge, catching the criminals he finds in his path, so he realizes that his destiny is to help people. But Dr. Connor, in turn, is forced to test his own experiment (a lizard serum that regenerates body limbs) on himself after his dismissal, which turns him into The Lizard. This will spread panic among the citizens, and Peter will be forced to use his powers. It is the first film of a cinematographic reboot of this character, since due to script problems Sony had canceled the fourth installment of Spider-Man, opting for this reboot. Marc Webb is in charge of directing the film, and he specializes in the world of music videos, in which groups such as Green Day, My Chemical Romance, Evanescence, Maroon 5 and Fergie have featured him. His only films are (500) Days Together and the first and second installment of this new Spider-Man saga. Andrew Garfield plays Peter Parker. He began in theater and acted in Leones por Corderos and the television film Boy A, which gave him recognition; just like his performance in The Social Network. Emma Stone plays Gwen Stacy, and participated in films such as Campus Bunny, Ghosts of My Ex-Girlfriends, Crazy, Stupid, Love or Entitled to Friction. His role in Easy A earned him a Golden Globe nomination.

programme.title: Pelham Train Assault 123
programme.desc: A criminal and his gang take over a subway car, threatening to kill the passengers one by one if they are not paid what is demanded. However, a subway worker who knows the tunnel system very well will make things quite difficult for you.

programme.title: The law of the street
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy joins a gang in Washington, but he is determined that his 10-year-old brother will not follow in his footsteps. Everything indicates that this will be his destiny, until he meets a war veteran.

programme.title: When the river rises
programme.desc: The story takes place in Tennessee. Despite the threat of a rising river and a poor harvest, Tom Garvey and his wife Mae, a young farming couple, are determined to preserve the land of their ancestors. But, burdened by debt, Tom is forced to become a scab during a strike at the local steel mill, leaving his wife to run the farm. Upon their return, they have to face not only the flooding of a furious river that can wash away the work of so many years but also a power-hungry landowner who covets the lands of the Garveys and their neighbors to satisfy his ambition.

programme.title: The skyscraper
programme.desc: Ten years ago, Will Sawyer was the head of the FBI's hostage rescue team. After a failed intervention with victims, Sawyer left his job at the FBI and now, married with two twin children, works evaluating the security of skyscrapers. On his trip to China for work, the police point him out as the sole culprit for the fire in the world's largest skyscraper, La Perla, because only he has unlimited access to the building's security system. Despite that, he manages to escape. While trying to capture the real culprits to prove his innocence, he must rescue his family who are trapped in the flames of the building and avoid being captured by the police. The objective of those responsible for the fire is to obtain compromised information that the owner of the building has.

programme.title: extreme chase
programme.desc: John Triton is a Marine returning home after being discharged from the Iraq War. Already in the United States, he has to take action again when his wife is kidnapped by a bloodthirsty mafia gang led by the cruel Rome. With everything at stake, John will not stop until he completes his toughest and most important mission.

programme.title: The agent
programme.desc: In the year 2030, the world is in a permanent state of economic recession and faces serious environmental problems as a result of global warming. All those citizens who are unproductive are exiled to a colony.

programme.title: Zooloco
programme.desc: The animals at Franklin Park Zoo adore their kind keeper, Griffin Keyes. When Griffin realizes that he is more comfortable with a lion than a lady, he decides that the only way to get a girl to share his life is to leave the zoo and look for a more glamorous job.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Matilda Wormwood is an extraordinary child, but her parents' ignorance prevents them from seeing their daughter's abilities. When she starts school she discovers that the students live under the dictatorship of Principal Trunchbull. Only Professor Honey will be able to discover his potential.

programme.title: stomping
programme.desc: Retired from the United States Army Special Forces, Chris Vaughn returns to his hometown eager to pick up his life where he left off. But time has made his home a dangerous place, as his high school rival, Jay Hamilton, has put the town at the service of crime. After being elected sheriff, Chris vows to restore peace.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner is a renowned scientist, with a murky family past, who suffers with his team a serious laboratory accident in which everyone is exposed to intense gamma radiation. When he discovers that he is the only one who has survived, he is confused and begins to investigate. But Bruce has developed a terrible ability after the accident that could hinder the investigation; when he gets angry he turns into a giant green monster with irrational and destructive behavior. To create the Hulk character using digital technology, the company Light & Magic made the largest technical deployment in its history. It was necessary to work together with one hundred and eighty ILM technicians and work on the character for more than a year and a half. Even so, there are viewers who have compared the technical quality of the Hulk to that of Shrek. In this film, Hulk reaches the largest size he had reached to date, nine meters tall. Ang Lee used the split-screen technique to cinematically imitate the panels of a comic book page. To do this, he had to shoot the same scene several times, which somewhat exhausted actor Eric Bana, who plays Brece Banner. Much of the microbiology work seen on screen is real, done by Ang Lee's wife.

programme.title: Point Break (Sin límites)
programme.desc: Remake of the film 'They Call Him Bodhi', directed in 1991 by Kathryn Bigelow ('The Darkest Night'). Johnny, a young FBI agent, infiltrates a team of elite athletes led by Boshi. Johnny's mission is to discover if the gang is behind a series of deaths and unusual robberies that are causing the world economy to plummet. Therefore, covertly and trying not to discover his true identity, the agent will have to risk his life to find evidence that will allow him to incriminate the gang and capture it. However, when he begins to form a friendship with the leader, Johnny will question whose side he is on and what he should do.

programme.title: Karate kid, the moment of truth
programme.desc: Young Daniel La Russo arrives in Los Angeles from the North American east coast and suddenly finds himself faced with the difficult task of making new friends. He soon becomes the object of all kinds of ridicule from the Cobras, a rather violent group of karate students. Fortunately, at the same time he begins a relationship of friendship and love with Ali, the former girlfriend of the leader of the Cobras. Eager to face his enemies and at the same time impress his new friend, Daniel asks Master Miyagi, a true martial arts expert, to teach him how to fight. He agrees and teaches Daniel all the secrets to control the body and mind. In this way he will be able to face the Cobras in the Regional Karate Championships with a minimum of chances of victory. Little by little, and advised by Miyagi's experience, Daniel develops not only his physical strength, but also the faith in himself and the confidence necessary to face the most important combat of his life. As expected, Daniel will reach the final and will face none other than the leader of the Cobras. Despite being injured in a leg, Daniel will use one of the most risky kicks to win the fight and become the new regional karate champion. This is the seventh film of the protagonist, Ralph Macchio, and marked his true launch in the cinema. After this two other films in the saga would come out, and two other versions starting in 2000, but which did not star Macchio. Pat Morita, who plays Miyagi, was best known for his role in 'Karate Kid', but he was a prolific actor with more than 160 films as an actor in his career.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: When Dre Parker and his mother move to China from Detroit, Dre finds himself alone in an unknown world. When some students harass and beat Dre, Mr. Han, the maintenance man at his building, a man who has suffered an irreparable loss, comes to his aid. Mr. Han takes pity on Dre and agrees to teach him Kung Fu so he can defend himself. By training together, teacher and student learn to trust each other and form a friendship that will heal all wounds.

programme.title: back to the future
programme.desc: Marty McFly is a teenager tired of his family. One day he receives a call from his friend Doc, a scientist whom everyone thinks is crazy, to show him his latest invention. It is a time machine that consists of a car powered by plutonium. Marty accidentally activates the machine, traveling back in time to 1955. In the past, Marty discovers his teenage parents and mistakenly avoids their first date. Marty must reunite his parents, convince Doc that he comes from the future and manage to travel back to the present. Initially, the role of Marty McFly was going to be played by Eric Stoltz. However, in the middle of filming, the directors fired Stoltz when they considered that he was not the right actor. Michael J. Fox, who had been an early choice, was committed to the show Family Ties at the time. However, after Stoltz's dismissal he was available to record the film and immediately accepted the role. Christopher Lloyd plays Doc. Lloyd initially turned down the role, but ultimately accepted it once he read the script. The film's director, Robert Zemeckis, along with the screenwriter, Bob Gale, had already been interested in the idea of ​​making a film about time travel. The final idea came after Gale reflected on the possibility of having become friends with his father if they had attended the same school. After Back to the Future, Robert Zemeckis directed other successful films such as Forrest Gump, Cast Away and Flight. The success of Back to the Future led to the production of a trilogy, as well as the creation of an animated series.

programme.title: Back to the future II
programme.desc: Marty, his girlfriend Jennifer and Doc travel to the future, to the year 2015, to prevent the couple's son from being imprisoned for a problem with the law. However, the presence of the temporary travelers will cause a bigger problem than the one they intended to fix and things will become increasingly complicated. The problem begins when Marty buys a sports almanac with all the results of the competitions up to the year 2000, in order to make easy money when he returns to the past. As in the first part, Marty McFly and Doc are played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. However, two of the actors from the first part, Crispin Glover and Claudia Wells, did not participate in the second part. Crispin Glover, who played Marty's father in the first part, was replaced by Jeffrey Weissman, who used facial prosthetics to look as much like Glover as possible. For her part, Elisabeth Shue was in charge of replacing Claudia Wells, who in the first part played Jennifer, Marty's girlfriend. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, the box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years spent building the sets and writing the script, filming began in February 1989. Without a doubt, the biggest challenge was creating the futuristic vision of Hill Valley. It should be noted that this second part and the third part of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously.

programme.title: Back to the future III
programme.desc: Stranded in 1955, Marty receives a letter from his friend Doc telling him that he is in 1885 and that the time machine is broken and cannot be repaired. Doc isn't worried about being stuck in the past, saying he's happy working as a blacksmith. However, Marty discovers an old grave in which he reads that Doc died in 1885, and decides to go rescue his friend. Using the time machine Doc had hidden in 1955, Marty travels to the Wild West, where he discovers that his friend has run afoul of a gang of bullies and fallen in love with a teacher. Using technology from the time, Marty and Doc must find a way to return to the future. Since the second and third parts of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously, there are no significant changes in the cast with respect to Back to the Future II, with MartyMcFly and Doc again played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. The most notable addition compared to the previous installments is that of Mary Steenburgen, playing Clara Clayton, the teacher with whom Doc falls in love in 1885. The idea of ​​traveling back in time to 1885 arose during the filming of the first film, when Robert Zemeckis asked J. Fox what historical period he would like to visit. Fox answered that it was the Wild West, and Zemeckis and Bob Gale decided to use this idea for the third part. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, the box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years dedicated to building the sets and writing the script, filming of the second and third parts (they were shot simultaneously) began in February 1989. Some scenes were filmed in Monument Valley. The train scenes were filmed at the Railtown 1987 State Historic Park, a historic train line located in Jamestown.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious (A todo gas)
programme.desc: FBI agent Brian O'Conner investigates a case of highway robberies from sports vehicles. To obtain information, he enters the world of illegal racing and infiltrates the gang led by Dominic Torreto, the main suspect. Everything will become even more complicated when he falls in love with his little sister, Mia.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious (A todo gas 2)
programme.desc: After botching an important investigation into illegal nighttime racing in Los Angeles due to his addiction to speed, Agent Brian O'Connor is tasked with arresting Carter Verone, a Miami businessman who uses his import-export business to launder money. To do this, he must infiltrate the clandestine racing drivers again.

programme.title: The red dragon
programme.desc: Will Graham is an FBI investigator specializing in examining the minds and behavior of serial killers. Will is forced to turn to Hannibal Lecter, whom he locked up years ago, to help him find out the conduct record of a ruthless family killer.

programme.title: A town called Dante's Peak
programme.desc: Harry Dalton (Pierce Brosnan) is one of the most renowned volcanologists at the United States Geological Survey. Four years after his partner's death during a volcanic eruption in Colombia, Harry receives a call from his boss, Paul Dyfrus (Charles Hallahan), to discuss the unusual behavior of a hitherto dormant volcano. Meanwhile, the city of Dante's Peak, located on one of the volcano's plains, is celebrating being named the second most desired place to live in the country. Harry begins his investigation in the area and discovers clear signs that the volcano could soon erupt. The scientist wants to put the city on alert, but the inhabitants have economic interests that could be harmed if they heed Harry's warnings. Everyone ignores it until it's too late. The director, Roger Donaldson, was drawn to the project because he was once a geology student. Many of the film's special effects were done practically. The ash from the volcano was actually very fine shavings of newspaper. According to an interview with Donaldson, the camera that Harry Dalton uses during his investigation is actually owned by Pierce Brosnan. Initially the main role was going to be played by Michael Douglas. Most of the film's exteriors were shot in Wallas, Idaho. It was also filmed on Dante's Peak, adding certain details with digital technology.

programme.title: Cross-fire
programme.desc: After witnessing the brutal murder of a store owner and his son, firefighter Jeremy Coleman miraculously escapes with his life. Having witnessed the murders and being forced to testify against the gang of gangsters that carried them out, specifically against their leader, David Hagan, he is integrated into the witness protection program under the supervision of the Marshalls. Agent Talia will be in charge of protecting Jeremy's life from this cruel murderer. Inspector Mike Calla will be in charge of handling Coleman's case, a man who precisely lost his wife at the hands of the same gangster who committed this crime, and who since then has not stopped searching for him to do justice. The problem comes when Jeremy Coleman's new identity is compromised, so the firefighter is forced to take action to recover his life and save those of his loved ones.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Matilda Wormwood is an extraordinary child, but her parents' ignorance prevents them from seeing their daughter's abilities. When she starts school she discovers that the students live under the dictatorship of Principal Trunchbull. Only Professor Honey will be able to discover his potential.

programme.title: Zooloco
programme.desc: The animals at Franklin Park Zoo adore their kind keeper, Griffin Keyes. When Griffin realizes that he is more comfortable with a lion than a lady, he decides that the only way to get a girl to share his life is to leave the zoo and look for a more glamorous job.

programme.title: stomping
programme.desc: Retired from the United States Army Special Forces, Chris Vaughn returns to his hometown eager to pick up his life where he left off. But time has made his home a dangerous place, as his high school rival, Jay Hamilton, has put the town at the service of crime. After being elected sheriff, Chris vows to restore peace.

programme.title: Red hot
programme.desc: Art Jeffries is an FBI agent with respect problems for his superiors. One day he is assigned to investigate the case of a missing boy, Simon, whose parents have been murdered. After finding him, he discovers that he is a nine-year-old autistic boy with a prodigious ability to reveal supposedly insurmountable government codes.

programme.title: The silence of the lambs
programme.desc: Promising FBI agent Clarice Starling is pulled from her special forces training by Jack Crawford of the FBI's Behavioral Study Unit. He wants me to study a notorious and eccentric psychopath named Habbibal Lecter, who was a forensic psychiatrist imprisoned for multiple murders and cannibalism. The purpose of the meetings between Clarice and Hannibal must be for the latter to agree to help her catch a serial killer named Buffalo Bill. But what the woman did not imagine was that Hannibal would turn out to be a sophisticated and cultured man restricted from others by glass walls. Although he is polite at first, he soon begins to lose patience when Clarice tries to create a psychological profile for him. While the hunts continue throughout Chicago and Buffalo Bill collects his kills without the FBI being able to do anything to solve it, Clarice will have to find a way to ingratiate herself with a man who ate the people around him and show him that, in addition to being intelligent, she is not afraid of him at all. Things will start to get difficult when the Senator's daughter disappears and everything indicates that Buffalo Bill has her and that soon her body will appear as a new victim. The events of this film take place after what happened in the film Hunter (1986). Although there are many characters in common in the two films, only two of the actors share films. Frankie Faison plays Lt. Fisk in Hunter and Barney in The Silence of the Lambs; On the other hand, Dan Butler plays the fingerprint expert FBI agent in Hunter and an entomologist in "The Silence of the Lambs."

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: 1945. James Francis Ryan's three brothers have died in combat within a few days of each other. The United States War Department orders that the last Ryan must be found and sent home immediately in compliance with the US military's sole survivor policy. Captain John Miller will be in charge of finding James. After German artillery kills members of his battalion during the Normandy landings, Miller assembles a group of seven men to help him accomplish his mission. The only thing he knows about Ryan's whereabouts is that he disappeared behind enemy lines after parachuting in with his squad. The team will risk their lives and travel across France in search of the soldier. During their journey they will have to fight to survive ambushes, snipers, lies and a bloody and cruel battle. The film, directed by Steven Spielberg, was a resounding success with critics. He received five Oscars, including best director, and two Golden Globes. It also took the box office by storm, grossing more than $480 million, making it the second highest-grossing film of 1998.

programme.title: The Kaiser's Last Kiss
programme.desc: A German officer is sent to Holland to determine whether the British Secret Service has infiltrated the home of Kaiser Wilhelm II, during the start of World War II, but begins a dangerous and lethal romance with a young Dutch Jew with consequences that neither of them could have foreseen.

programme.title: Essence of woman
programme.desc: Remake of the film 'Scent of a Woman', from 1974. Charlie is a young man who studies at a private school thanks to a scholarship. In order to get some money, he works on weekends. One day, he becomes the guide for a rude retired colonel who suffers from blindness and is ready to commit suicide. Little by little, the cold relationship between the two grows closer into a beautiful friendship that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Target: The White House
programme.desc: Secret Service Agent Mike Banning is assigned to desk duty at the Federal Reserve after saving the life of US President Asher Benjamin in a car accident. However, he was unable to rescue the First Lady. A year later, a North Korean commando led by a terrorist named Kang carries out an attack on Washington and manages to capture President Asher and his cabinet, holding them hostage in the White House bunker itself. It's a desperate situation and Mike will have to take responsibility for the rescue.

programme.title: sealed chamber
programme.desc: Having survived the hatred and intolerance inherited from his grandfather, young lawyer Adam Hall seeks at the last minute to appeal the old man's death sentence for a crime committed thirty years ago in which he is accused of murdering two young Jewish children. Just four weeks before Sam Cayhall is executed, Adam finds himself for the first time in the Mississippi prison where he has been since the crime. The meeting is visibly tense when the young man faces the insults that the old man says, but when he leaves prison and sees that the press has published in big headlines that he intends to save his grandfather, things begin to get complicated. Ron Howard was the original director of the film, but left the project to focus on 'Rescue'. Even so, he remained as executive producer. At the same time, Brad Pitt was offered to star in the film but he was busy making 'Rescue'. William Goldman, who wrote the first scripts, was very disappointed with the changes made to his sketches and never saw the finished film.

programme.title: Abandoned: Searching for Soldier Dad
programme.desc: DNA detectives track down the British soldiers who fathered children in Kenya then disappeared, leaving the children and their mothers without support. It's a quest to find a missing part of the children's identities. With access to every stage of this cutting-edge process, we follow as a team of lawyers and a leading geneticist travel to Kenya to help locate the British soldiers who fathered children then vanished. We witness the groundbreaking legal and scientific detective work used to find the missing dads. Lawyers believe British soldiers stationed at the army base in Nanyuki, Kenya, may have fathered hundreds of children over decades - the oldest we meet is now 70, the youngest just 18 months old. What's at stake is more than the reputation of the British army and the UK's post-colonial legacy. The mixed-heritage children have in some cases been ostracised by their communities and denied a chance of British citizenship since birth - something which could transform their lives.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: 'Meat proxy' is a new term coined to describe someone who acts as a human conduit for material generated by AI. Software engineer Niklas Gruhn, who came up with the phrase, joins Will Oremus of The Atlantic and Fortune's Diane Brady to discuss how much AI is being used in journalism and when readers should be told about it. Five years after US troops withdrew from Afghanistan and the Taliban returned to power, Lyse Doucet has been back in the country, including visiting one of the secret schools set up for girls. BBC News' Chief International Correspondent discusses what it takes to report from Afghanistan now, the restrictions she encountered and the difficult decisions involved in protecting contributors. A new series of The Grand Tour has three new presenters following the departure of Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May. This time, social media creators are taking over the long-running motoring show. Phil Churchward, its director and executive producer, explains how they were chosen.

programme.title: Pacar Dari Langit
programme.desc: Karena ayahnya sakit. Mega terpaksa pulang ke kampung halaman dan jatuh cinta kepada alien bernama Zen. yang berjanji akan selalu menjaganya.

programme.title: Salon Madam : Rambut Api
programme.desc: Seorang wanita datang ke Salon Madam untuk mengecat rambutnya dan mempercantik penampilannya, tapi cantik itu luka, dan rambutnya bisa menjadi petaka membara jika tak digunakan dengan bijak.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat Kamera Masa Lalu
programme.desc: Jack, seorang detektif junior ditugaskan menyelidiki kasus pencurian. Ketika menuju lokasi Jack lupa membawa kamera, terpaksa ia mencari kamera hingga berhenti di sebuah toko benda antik dan membeli kamera.

programme.title: Hijab Yang Tertukar
programme.desc: Kiara terjebak dalam situasi yang mengharuskan ia berpura-pura menjadi Anisa, seorang perempuan yang dijodohkan dengan Fachri. Saat Annisa asli datang, Fachri pun kesulitan untuk memilih antara Kiara atau Anisa.

programme.title: Cincin Wali
programme.desc: Pemuda dari kota datang ke desa, dan melihat gadis yang pernah ditemuinya dalam mimpi. Dia memutuskan untuk tinggal di pesantren yang sama dengan gadis tersebut. Namun, untuk mendapatkan gadis itu dia harus memperoleh cincin wali

programme.title: MJ is beautiful
programme.desc: Jamilah pengagum berat Michael Jackson, memutuskan untuk melanjutkan sekolah di Jakarta agar bisa bertemu dengan idolanya, Fadly Jackson. Namun yang dia dapatkan adalah ejekan dan hinaan. Berhasilkah Jamilah mewujudkan impiannya?

programme.title: Bidadari Di Kebun Strawberry
programme.desc: Misi yang dijalankan seharusnya mudah, yaitu menaikkan penjualan strawberry, tapi ada saja yang menghalangi usahanya termasuk pria tampan yang tiba-tiba muncul.

programme.title: Ditinju Cinta
programme.desc: Meskipun ibunya melarang, Indah tetap ingin menjadi seorang petinju. Saat sanggar tinju mengeluarkannya karena kesalahan pengisian data, Indah belajar kepada seorang rekan sesama petinju. Dan cinta tumbuh di antara mereka berdua.

programme.title: Married Failed
programme.desc: Raline bersama Rega, pacarnya, berencana untuk menikah. Segala persiapan pernikahan sudah dirancang Raline. Tiba-tiba Rega bertemu dengan Nesha, mantan pacarnya, dan masih saling menyukai.

programme.title: Jubah Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Sinta, gadis cantik dan ambisius dari keluarga kurang mampu. Setelah menemukan Jubah Tak Kasat Mata di toko Kr. Amat, dia menyusup masuk ke rumah Poppy dan mencuri uang dari brankas. Tapi ternyata jubah tersebut membawa kutukan.

programme.title: Cintaku Tak Seindah FTV
programme.desc: Ada tetangga baru yang bikin Alya kepincut dengan ketampanannya. Ramzi, cowok ganteng dan keren itu bikin Alya penasaran. Alya seorang penulis FTV, kerap menulis cerita percintaan. Apakah kisah nyatanya bakal seindah cerita FTV?

programme.title: Bangkitnya Rawa Rontek
programme.desc: Rontek, seorang pendekar jahat yang menguasai ilmu hitam bernama 'rawa rontek' yang bisa menjadikannya kebal. Suatu ketika Rontek harus menghadapi lawan tangguh yang memiliki ilmu 'pancasona'.

programme.title: Kecantol Raja Minyak
programme.desc: Ferdi adalah penjual minyak wangi pinggir jalan yang kerap dikejar Satpol PP. Ira adalah Satpol PP tetangga Ferdi yang memiliki masalah bau badan. Ferdi berusaha membantu mengatasi masalah itu, dan mereka pun kian dekat.

programme.title: Kecantol Derek Cinta
programme.desc: Mona dan Ryan dipertemukan karena derek mobil, atau lebih tepatnya karena mobilnya diderek oleh Ryan karena melanggar peraturan parkir. Apa kisah mereka hanya sampai di sini?

programme.title: Harta Karun Nenek Bajak
programme.desc: Putri mempunyai kekasih yang terlibat hutang bernama Draco. Saat sedang terdesak dia teringat bahwa dia memiliki kenalan bernama Mira yang memiliki nenek kaya raya bernama Nenek Bajak di kampungnya. Putri menipu Nenek Bajak.

programme.title: Terdampar Di Pulau Kosong
programme.desc: Tomi mengajak teman-teman sekelas liburan di sebuah pulau.Tomi ajak Hani jalan-jalan dengan speedboat. Ditengah laut speedboat hilang kendali. Tomi menyelamatkan diri sendiri dan Hani ditinggal terdampar di pulau tak berpenghuni.

programme.title: Tempe Mendoan Bumbu Cinta
programme.desc: Marvin adalah cowok tampan kaya raya yang sayang neneknya, dan sang nenek ingin sekali makan tempe mendoan. Marvin pun tak tahu pencariannya akan hidangan itu akan membawanya ke kisah asmara.

programme.title: Tempe Mendoan Bumbu Cinta
programme.desc: Marvin adalah cowok tampan kaya raya yang sayang neneknya, dan sang nenek ingin sekali makan tempe mendoan. Marvin pun tak tahu pencariannya akan hidangan itu akan membawanya ke kisah asmara.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: Saat berandalan Zhen dan sahabatnya Chia mengumpulkan bukti-bukti korupsi para pejabat, mereka menuntut untuk menjadi gubernur di negara itu.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: Seorang pahlawan wanita terlibat dalam cinta segitiga dengan seorang pendekar pedang dan seorang prajurit saat bekerja sama untuk menaklukkan kekuatan jahat di dunia seni bela diri.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Kisah cinta antara sesosok peri nan memikat yang turun dari surga untuk menjalani kehidupan di Hong Kong pada tahun 70-an dengan seorang pria yang mengelola sebuah panti asuhan yang terlilit hutang.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Tiga sekawan menemukan sebuah artefak langka, tapi mereka diracun oleh Nyonya Wu yang ingin mencurinya. Sebelum tewas, ketiganya meminta istri mereka berjanji guna melatih anak mereka untuk mengambilnya kembali.

programme.title: Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Dalam kisah ini, seorang penjahat bernama Sung Ching-shu kembali menebarkan terornya. Ia menjebak seorang putri Mongolia yang cantik dan menguasai ilmu 'gabungan yin dan yang' yang menjadikannya tak terkalahkan.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: Opera Huangmei yang epik ini dibintangi oleh Li Li-hua dan Ivy Ling Po dalam kisah tentang seorang pelayan Istana yang menyerahkan putranya yang baru lahir, demi menyelamatkan sang pangeran dari seorang pejabat jahat.

programme.title: The Beautiful
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai dan Fanny Fan bergabung dengan grup menari asuhan Kao Pao-shu. Linda dan putra Kao sang manajer grup, Peter Chen, mengalami salah paham dan akhirnya saling membenci.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Sutradara asal Jepang, Inoue Umetsugu, menyuguhkan dunia gemerlap dari para penghibur di klub malam dalam sebuah kisah tentang perjuangan dua kakak beradik yang diperankan oleh Irene Chen Yi Ling dan Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: Seorang seniman bela diri muda dan terpelajar ditugaskan oleh kaisar Qing untuk memata-matai para pembangkang di provinsi lain yang berencana untuk menggulingkannya. Ia menyusup ke perkebunan besar pemimpin pemberontak dengan menjadi guru privat cucunya.

programme.title: Ode To Gallantry
programme.desc: Dalam petualangan seni bela diri 'Venoms' yang sangat menarik ini, seorang pengembara berulang kali dikira sebagai orang lain dan ia pun terseret ke dalam sejumlah pertarungan sengit.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: Idola tahun '70-an, Hsing Hui dan Yon Fan, membintangi film horor yang bercerita tentang pengusaha muda yang menikahi wanita muda nan cantik tanpa menyadari jika sang gadis dirasuki oleh iblis.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David jatuh cinta pada Dan Feng dan menikahinya. Saudari David yang bernama Mona jatuh cinta dengan sahabatnya, Han Ming. Karena cemburu, Mona berbohong tentang perselingkuhan antara Han Ming dan Dan Feng.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David jatuh cinta pada Dan Feng dan menikahinya. Saudari David yang bernama Mona jatuh cinta dengan sahabatnya, Han Ming. Karena cemburu, Mona berbohong tentang perselingkuhan antara Han Ming dan Dan Feng.

programme.title: Perils Of Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Seorang ahli bela diri merekayasa upaya pembunuhan terhadap seorang pangeran, untuk menyamar di 'Desa Hantu', tempat tersembunyi di mana para penjahat buronan bersembunyi. Sesampainya di sana, ia mulai menyelidiki pemimpin mereka yang penuh rahasia.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: Dalam tradisi Opera Huangmei, film ini menceritakan kisah cinta Wen, yang menjual dirinya sebagai budak ke sebuah keluarga kaya, dan Huo, seorang putri muda dari keluarga itu.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Bintang pop di tahun '60-an, Carrie Ku Mei, berperan sebagai 'Burung Kecil' dalam film romantis tentang salah identitas ini yang menampilkan beberapa lagu Mandarin paling populer sepanjang masa.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang pasukan tentara yang pergi untuk menghancurkan geng Hsien Lung, yang merupakan kelompok revolusioner anti-Yuan. Pemimpin mereka Ru Yi Tu melawan Fu Zhong Yuan, penerus kelompok Hsien Lung.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan dan muridnya Fan bekerja mengangkut zombie. Saat mereka berdua melarikan diri, ternyata salah satu dari mereka sebenarnya adalah seorang pria yang sedang menyamar dan kabur dari musuh-musuhnya.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Kisah ini terjadi di sebuah apartemen kuno yang dihuni oleh berbagai karakter. Seorang pengembang properti berupaya memiliki apartemen itu untuk dibangun kembali.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: Kisah nyata tentang industri film Hong Kong yang disutradarai oleh Li Han Hsiang ini menggambarkan saat-saat paling menyenangkan dan paling aktual di suatu era seperti yang dimuat dalam kolom gosip surat kabar.

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Dua polisi dengan sifat berbeda ditugaskan untuk menangkap seorang bos narkoba. Yang satu melakukan segalanya sesuai hukum dan yang satunya melakukan apa pun demi menuntaskan kejahatan.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix adalah karya besar lain dari sutradara Li Han-hsiang. Sebuah film komedi seputar peristiwa-peristiwa menjelang pernikahan putri sang perdana menteri.

programme.title: The Lady Is The Boss
programme.desc: Akademi milik Wong Hsia Yuan sang ahli kungfu tradisional hampir ditutup. Chan Mei Ling tiba dari Amerika Serikat untuk merevitalisasi akademi tersebut, tetapi caranya merekrut siswa melanggar hukum yang berlaku.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu dan rekannya tengah melakukan sebuah misi untuk menghancurkan 'Phoenix Lute', sebuah senjata mematikan yang dapat menembakkan jarum-jarum beracun dan hanya dapat dihancurkan oleh pedang lengkung Kan.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Beberapa bintang wanita terbesar Shaw Brothers di tahun 1970-an tampil bersama dalam kisah tentang cinta dan orangtua yang terlampau ikut campur. Dibintangi oleh Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei dan Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: Sebuah opera menarik yang menceritakan tentang Fei E, putri seorang Jenderal yang menyamar sebagai seorang anak laki-laki dan menipu semua orang, termasuk dua sahabatnya di sekolah.

programme.title: The Spirit Of The Sword
programme.desc: Ketua Klan Air terluka parah oleh seorang samurai pembunuh sesaat sebelum duel tahunan di Danau Taihu. Ia menugaskan saudaranya Bao Yu dalam perjalanan panjang untuk menemukan obat untuknya.

programme.title: Na Cha The Great
programme.desc: Film klasik karya Chang Cheh yang diangkat dari kisah fantasi populer ini dibintangi oleh Fu Sheng dalam perannya yang khas sebagai remaja super Na Cha, yang bereinkarnasi untuk menyelamatkan penduduk dari kaisar kejam.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Dalam Pale Passion, disutradarai oleh Chin Ping-hsing, Chiang Li-ping berperan sebagai Ah Hsia dalam kisah perselingkuhan, perzinahan dan pengkhianatan yang menyebabkan cinta segitiga berdarah.

programme.title: Disciples Of The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Sutradara film bela diri nan legendaris, Lau Kar-leung, menuai pujian saat menyutradarai film yang menampilkan Gordon Liu sebagai San Te si biksu berjubah emas seperti dalam film The 36th Chamber Of Shaolin.

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty
programme.desc: Aktris muda Linda Lin Dai tampil memukau sebagai seorang gadis desa yang menjalin hubungan gelap dengan Kaisar Cheng-Te, pria yang ia cintai seumur hidupnya.

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Kuo jatuh cinta pada Gadis Naga saat tengah mempelajari seni permainan pedang. Namun, mereka tidak bisa menikah karena jalinan cinta antara guru dan murid adalah suatu hal yang terlarang.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: Yu Nan adalah seorang penjudi kambuhan. Ia menjadikan istrinya sebagai uang muka atas utangnya. Ia pun menyesal dan memutuskan untuk bunuh diri, namun niatnya dihentikan oleh kemunculan sesosok hantu cantik.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai memerankan tokoh Pak Su-cheng, dewi ular nan mempesona yang memilih wujud sebagai seorang wanita sehingga ia dapat merasakan indahnya kehidupan manusia!

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Pengemis Su dan saudaranya berlatih tanpa henti demi mengalahkan seorang pencuri sadis yang dijuluki Sang Lipan.

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun tak mau menyuap seorang pelukis kekaisaran sehingga si pelukis menggambar potret jelek dirinya, yang membuatnya tak dipilih oleh Kaisar sampai mereka bertemu langsung.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Perancang busana Shi tidak terima dengan kritik Mui kala memintanya untuk mengomentari desain barunya. Saat Mui memintanya untuk merancang gaun untuk menghadiri pesta, Shi membalas dendam dengan membuat kostum badut.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh mengemban misi pertamanya sambil diam-diam menyelidiki penyebab pembantaian keluarganya beberapa tahun silam. Namun, ia malah terjerat dalam suatu konspirasi politik saat menjalankan misi.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha serakah dari Hong Kong menyewa seorang pemburu muda untuk menangkap gorila raksasa yang konon hidup jauh di dalam hutan India. Pemburu itu menemukan kera tersebut, dan hidup bersamanya ia menemukan seorang wanita liar yang telah berteman dengan makhluk itu.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun adalah seorang ahli bela diri terampil yang bertarung untuk membalas dendam atas kematian sang kekasih dengan bantuan dari seorang pemimpin geng pengemis.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Paman Hua adalah pensiunan agen yang memiliki toko barang antik di sebuah jalan tua. Namun, jalan itu dihancurkan secara paksa oleh Geng Naga Hijau setempat, dan membuat identitas Paman Hua tak sengaja terungkap.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man

Seorang Pendeta Tao dan dua muridnya berusaha menghentikan teror tersebut.

Baru setelah mereka bersama-sama pergi ke alam liar untuk mencari muntahan burung hantu yang berisi tulang-belulang Peepeep, Meral akhirnya memahami arti sebenarnya dari persahabatan. programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Their reputation is legendary, rally enthusiasts adore them: the monster rally cars of the so-called Group B. At the beginning of the 80s, a new classification entered rally sport. Suddenly turbocharged all-wheel-drive racing vehicles with up to 500 hp race across the international slopes. The drivers can barely control the vehicles, but with their sound and unbridled power they exert a huge fascination. Only the most serious accidents with dead drivers and fans put an end to the absolute irrationality. Today these cars enjoy cult status and are expensive collector's items. Also legendary: the BMW M E30 in the DTM version. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: This gripping Top Speed ​​episode is all about the passion for old metal. Moderator Martin Utberg uses the book Passion Oldtimer by Richard Kaan as a source of inspiration. Based on the themes covered in the book, Martin visits three classic car collectors who answer the question of what drives a collector. He also drives a beautiful Maserati Ghibli and curator Emmanuel Bacquet shows the world famous Karosas collection and lastly Daniel Swarovski, great-grandson of the legendary founder of the Swarovski Group, explains the difference between patina and full restoration. (Station info).
